Provenance Tracking

PRo3D has several features for manual, semi-automatic and automatic provenace tracking which have been developed in the PROVEX project. The features need to be enabled by command-line-arguments as such: --disableCors --port 4321 --remoteApi --enableProvenance

DisableCors is required when running PRo3D UI from the PROVEX web app. For communication with the webapp the remoteApi needs to be enabled. To enable provenace features from within PRo3D `–enable-Provenance``is needed.

More about this stream of features was presented at ASTRA2023 and in the provex specific documentation: https://github.com/pro3d-space/PRo3D/tree/features/provex/provex
